Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 38% independent neighbours on the funding graph. A tight ring of 72 clones as a result holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. That is 37 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
